page.title: Settings
page.subtitle: How each module behaves in your hospital. Only modules you have switched on are listed.
page.leaveMessage: Your changes to {{name}} settings will be lost.

requiredFields.label: Required at registration
requiredFields.help: Name and gender are always required.

duplicateCheck.label: Check for duplicates while registering
duplicateCheck.help: Looks for the same mobile, Aadhaar or a similar name with the same age.

blockOnExactDuplicate.label: Block registration when the same Aadhaar exists

seniorAge.label: Senior citizen from age
seniorAge.help: Patients this old are suggested the Senior citizen category.

allowOverbooking.label: Allow booking a slot that is already taken
allowOverbooking.help: For walk-ins at busy clinics. Overbooked slots are marked.

followUpDays.label: Follow-up window (days)
followUpDays.help: A visit to the same doctor within this many days is booked as a follow-up.

remindDayBefore.label: Remind patients the day before
remindDayBefore.help: About 24 hours before the appointment, by the channels set in Notification rules.

remindHoursBefore.label: Remind again this many hours before

noShowAfterMinutes.label: Mark no-show this many minutes after the slot
noShowAfterMinutes.help: Booked patients who never checked in. 0 leaves it to the front desk.

onlineBooking.label: Patients can book online
onlineBooking.help: A public booking page (link on Doctors & schedules). Patients confirm their mobile number with a one-time SMS code.

enabled.label: Patients can sign in to the portal
enabled.help: With their mobile number and a one-time SMS code. Off: the portal address shows nothing.

familyAccess.label: Family members on one mobile share one sign-in
familyAccess.help: Off: a patient picks who they are once they sign in, and sees only their own records.

bookingDaysAhead.label: Patients can book up to (days ahead)

maxOpenBookings.label: Upcoming portal bookings allowed per patient

cancelHoursBefore.label: Patients can cancel up to (hours before)
cancelHoursBefore.help: 0: right up to the appointment time.

seniorPriority.label: Seniors go ahead in the queue
seniorPriority.help: Uses the senior-citizen age from Settings › Patients.

announce.label: Announce tokens on the TV display

requireVitals.label: Vitals must be recorded before the doctor signs
requireVitals.help: Off: the doctor sees a reminder but can still sign.

signRequiresPin.label: Doctors sign consults with a PIN
signRequiresPin.help: Each doctor sets a 4–6 digit signing PIN in My workspace.

rxLanguage.label: Prescription directions language
rxLanguage.help: Directions are printed in English and, below them, in this language.

bookFollowUp.label: Book the follow-up when the doctor signs
bookFollowUp.help: Takes the first free slot with the same doctor on the follow-up date. The patient is told.

breakGlassHours.label: Emergency access (break-the-glass) lasts (hours)
breakGlassHours.help: Opening a chart outside one’s usual access is logged, the administrators are told, and access ends after this long.

chargeConsultation.label: Charge the consultation when the patient checks in
chargeConsultation.help: Uses the doctor’s new / follow-up fee from Doctors & schedules.

chargeOrders.label: Charge tests and procedures when the doctor signs
chargeOrders.help: They wait at the billing counter as pending items.

allowDue.label: Allow saving a bill that is not fully paid
allowDue.help: The balance shows as due and can be collected later.

roundOff.label: Round bills to the nearest rupee

upiId.label: UPI ID for QR payments
upiId.help: e.g. citycare@okaxis — the counter shows a QR with the exact amount.

collectOnlyWhenBilled.label: Collect samples only after the tests are billed
collectOnlyWhenBilled.help: Off: collect first and bill later (common for inpatients and emergencies).

verifyRequiresPin.label: Pathologists verify results with their signing PIN

autoVerifyNormal.label: Verify automatically when every value is normal
autoVerifyNormal.help: Abnormal and critical results always need a pathologist.

requireDeposit.label: Ask for the minimum deposit at admission
requireDeposit.help: The minimum is set per bed category. Emergencies can still be admitted with a reason.

consentText.label: General consent read to the patient at admission

vitalsEveryHours.label: Take vitals every (hours)
vitalsEveryHours.help: Patients whose last vitals are older than this show as due on the ward board.

marWindowMinutes.label: A dose counts as on time within (minutes)

highAlertWitness.label: High-alert medicines need a second nurse to witness

verifyMedOrders.label: A pharmacist checks medicine orders before they reach the nurses
verifyMedOrders.help: A STAT dose can be given before the check.

issueDays.label: Pharmacy issues medicines for (days) at a time

scanToGive.label: Scan the wristband and the medicine before charting a dose given
scanToGive.help: Off: scanning is optional and the MAR records whether it was done.

chargeConsumables.label: Charge consumables used from ward stock to the patient

chargeRegistration.label: Charge the ER registration fee on arrival
chargeRegistration.help: Treatment never waits for payment; charges are settled when the patient leaves or move to the admission.

turnoverMinutes.label: Cleaning time between cases (minutes)
turnoverMinutes.help: Kept free after each case when checking for clashes.

signOpNoteWithPin.label: Surgeons sign the operation note with their PIN

finalBillNeedsFinalApproval.label: Hold the final bill until the payer’s final approval
finalBillNeedsFinalApproval.help: Off: the final bill uses whatever amount is approved so far as the payer’s share.

defaultCreditDays.label: Payer credit period (days)
defaultCreditDays.help: Used for new payers; claims older than this show as overdue.

codingTargetDays.label: Code a discharge within (days)
codingTargetDays.help: Coding tasks older than this show as late.

completeWithinDays.label: Records complete within (days of discharge)
completeWithinDays.help: Incomplete records older than this show as overdue to the doctor.

requestTatDays.label: Release requested records within (days)
requestTatDays.help: The turnaround promised to the person asking.

requestFee.label: Usual fee for a copy of the records (₹)
requestFee.help: Filled in on a new request; can be changed or waived.

expiringSoonDays.label: Show sterile sets as expiring soon (days ahead)

separationWindowHours.label: Prepare FFP, platelets and cryo within (hours of collection)

sampleValidHours.label: A patient’s cross-match sample is valid for (hours)

requireAhg.label: Red-cell cross-match needs the AHG (indirect Coombs) phase
requireAhg.help: Off: an immediate-spin cross-match is enough when the antibody screen is negative.

reservationHours.label: Hold cross-matched units for the patient for (hours)
reservationHours.help: Unissued reservations go back to stock after this.

returnWindowMinutes.label: Unused units can come back to stock within (minutes of issue)

nearExpiryDays.label: Warn about units expiring within (days)
nearExpiryDays.help: Short-lived platelets warn in their last day.

chargeIssues.label: Charge issued units to the patient
chargeIssues.help: Processing charge per unit, on the patient’s bill or inpatient account.

chargeWb.label: Processing charge — whole blood (₹ per unit)

chargePrbc.label: Processing charge — packed red cells (₹ per unit)

chargeFfp.label: Processing charge — fresh frozen plasma (₹ per unit)

chargePlt.label: Processing charge — platelet concentrate (₹ per unit)

verifyBedCleaning.label: A supervisor checks a cleaned bed before it is free
verifyBedCleaning.help: Off: a bed is free as soon as the cleaner marks it done.

bedTargetMinutes.label: Target time to turn a bed around (minutes)

chargeTrips.label: Charge completed trips to the patient
chargeTrips.help: Posted on the patient’s bill, or on the inpatient account when the patient is admitted.

includedKm.label: Kilometres included in the base fare

waitingPer15Min.label: Waiting charge per 15 minutes after that (₹)

oxygenCharge.label: Oxygen used in transit (₹ per trip)

ventilatorCharge.label: Ventilator used in transit (₹ per trip)

docWarnDays.label: Warn about vehicle insurance, fitness and PUC expiry (days before)

weekOffDays.label: Weekly off days (staff not on a roster)
weekOffDays.help: Rostered staff follow their roster; an employee can have their own weekly off.

defaultShift.label: Shift code for staff not on a roster
defaultShift.help: A code from Duty roster › Shifts, e.g. G (general, 09:00–17:00).

lateGraceMinutes.label: Late after this many minutes past the shift start

earlyGraceMinutes.label: Early exit when leaving this many minutes before the shift end

halfDayBelowPct.label: Half day when worked less than (% of the shift)

absentBelowPct.label: Absent when worked less than (% of the shift)
absentBelowPct.help: A punch with no partner (forgot to punch out or in) is flagged as a missed punch; only the paired time counts until it is corrected, so a lone punch is absent.

maxWeeklyHours.label: Most hours a person may be rostered in a week

minRestHours.label: Least rest between two shifts (hours)
minRestHours.help: Catches a night shift followed by the next morning.

attendanceCalc.label: Worked time is counted
attendanceCalc.help: Paired: staff can punch out and back in several times a day (breaks, going home in a split shift) and only the time between each in and its out counts. First to last: the time from the first punch to the last.

options.PAIRED: Pair every in with its out (breaks are not worked time)

minBreakMinutes.label: Breaks shorter than this are counted as worked (minutes)
minBreakMinutes.help: Paired counting only. 0 deducts every break.

selfAttendance.label: Staff can mark themselves in and out (My workspace)

geofence.label: Where staff may mark themselves in and out
geofence.help: Checks the phone’s or browser’s location against the attendance sites of the person’s branch (Core › Branches). The location is read only at the moment they mark attendance — never tracked. Biometric, imported and HR-entered punches are not checked. HR can exempt field staff on their employee record.

options.WARN: Allow, but flag punches outside an attendance site
options.REQUIRED: Block — only within an attendance site

geofenceMaxAccuracyM.label: Refuse a location rougher than (metres)
geofenceMaxAccuracyM.help: Phones indoors can be off by a few hundred metres; the punch is refused (or flagged) when the location is less accurate than this.

roundingMinutes.label: Round worked time to the nearest (minutes)
roundingMinutes.help: 0 keeps worked time exact; 5 or 15 rounds each day’s net worked time before it is judged (half day, overtime). Attendance policies can set their own.

compOffMinMinutes.label: List overtime for approval from (minutes beyond the shift)
compOffMinMinutes.help: Leave › Setup › Overtime: net time worked beyond the shift (or on a day off) of at least this much waits for a decision — comp-off, paid, or rejected.

credentialAlertDays.label: Warn about expiring licences and certificates (days before)
credentialAlertDays.help: Each warning goes out once; another when it has expired.

documentAlertDays.label: Warn about expiring HR documents (days before)

idCardOrientation.label: Staff ID card layout
idCardOrientation.help: Both are the standard bank-card size (CR80) that fits card holders, lanyards and card printers.

idCardTitle.label: Heading on the staff ID card
idCardTitle.help: Printed in the coloured band, e.g. Staff ID card or Employee identity card.

idCardColor.label: Staff ID card colour
idCardColor.help: A colour code like #0E7C86. Leave it blank to use the hospital’s brand colour from the Hospital profile.

idCardFields.label: Shown on the staff ID card
idCardFields.help: The name and employee code are always printed. The QR code is a link that shows on any phone whether the card is valid.

idCardValidYears.label: Staff ID cards are valid for (years)
idCardValidYears.help: Valid until = the day the card is printed plus this many years. 0: the card has no expiry date.

idCardBack.label: Print a back side on staff ID cards
idCardBack.help: Each card’s back follows its front, so double-sided printing lines up.

idCardBackText.label: Rules printed on the back of the card

idCardReturnText.label: Return note on the back of the card
idCardReturnText.help: Followed by the hospital’s name, address and phone number.

idCardSignatory.label: Caption under the signature line
idCardSignatory.help: e.g. HR Manager or Medical Superintendent.

chargeMeals.label: Charge each delivered meal to the inpatient account

askAfterDischarge.label: Send a feedback link when an inpatient is discharged
askAfterDischarge.help: Not sent after a death or when the patient absconded.

askAfterOpd.label: Send a feedback link when the doctor signs an OPD consult

complaintFromDetractor.label: Open a complaint when a patient scores 0–6
complaintFromDetractor.help: Patient relations then calls the patient back.

scanOnlyWhenBilled.label: Scan only after the study is billed

signRequiresPin.label: Radiologists sign reports with their signing PIN

pcpndtRequired.label: Obstetric ultrasound needs Form F before scanning (PC & PNDT Act)
pcpndtRequired.help: Switch off only where the Act does not apply.

imageMaxFileMb.label: Largest image file accepted (MB)
imageMaxFileMb.help: Per DICOM or photo file uploaded to an imaging study.

imageMaxExamMb.label: Images allowed per study (MB, all files together)
imageMaxExamMb.help: 1024 MB = 1 GB. A thin-slice CT can be several hundred MB.

portalImages.label: Patients can view their images in the patient portal
portalImages.help: Only for studies whose report is signed, and only when the portal shows radiology reports.

anonymiseDefault.label: Tick “Remove patient identity” by default when sharing or exporting a study
anonymiseDefault.help: Staff can still untick it for a patient’s own CD.

alwaysAnonymiseShares.label: Always remove patient identity from images shared with outside doctors
alwaysAnonymiseShares.help: Shared links then show only age and sex, and images are de-identified as they are opened. Text burned into ultrasound or screen-capture images can’t be removed.

nearExpiryDays.label: Warn about expiry this many days ahead

countTolerancePct.label: Physical count: recount a line when it differs from the system by more than (%)
countTolerancePct.help: 0 means every line with any difference is counted a second time before the count can be submitted.

countBlindDefault.label: Physical count: blind counts by default (counters do not see the system quantity)

countPostBySeparateUser.label: Physical count: someone who did not count must approve and post it
countPostBySeparateUser.help: Switch off only where one person runs the store alone.

allowSubstitution.label: Allow dispensing another brand of the same generic

saleWithoutRx.label: Allow counter sales without a prescription
saleWithoutRx.help: Schedule H1 and X medicines always need the prescriber’s name.

autoPost.label: Post bills, receipts, purchases and payroll to the ledger automatically
autoPost.help: Off: nothing posts on its own; use Journals › Rebuild postings for a period when you are ready.

doctorTdsPct.label: TDS on doctor payouts (%)
doctorTdsPct.help: Section 194J. Pre-filled on new payout rules.

supplierTdsPct.label: TDS usually deducted on supplier payments (%)
supplierTdsPct.help: Pre-filled when recording a supplier payment.

matchWindowDays.label: Bank reconciliation: match entries within (days)
matchWindowDays.help: A statement line is suggested against book entries of the same amount this many days either side.

warnDays.label: Flag warranty, AMC/CMC, PM and calibration due within (days)
warnDays.help: Shown as “due soon” on the register and the maintenance list.

alertDays.label: Notify the biomedical team this many days before warranty, AMC/CMC or calibration runs out
alertDays.help: Comma-separated; one notification at each, and one more once it has run out.

pmLeadDays.label: Open the PM / calibration work order this many days before it is due

notifyAllBreakdowns.label: Notify the biomedical team of every new breakdown
notifyAllBreakdowns.help: Off: only critical breakdowns and critical equipment ring the bell.

defaultAppLanguage.label: Default hospital language
defaultAppLanguage.help: Default interface language for staff and patient portal.

enabledLanguages.label: Enabled languages for this hospital
enabledLanguages.help: Which languages appear in the language selector dropdown.

sessionIdleMinutes.label: Default sign-out after inactivity (minutes)
sessionIdleMinutes.help: Roles can set their own value.

patientMessageLanguage.label: Send patient messages in their language
patientMessageLanguage.help: SMS, WhatsApp and email use the patient’s preferred language for the standard texts; a text you have edited in Notification rules is sent as written. SMS in an Indian language is delivered only if that version is also registered on DLT.

patientLinkDays.label: Links sent to patients work for (days)
patientLinkDays.help: Prescriptions and lab reports sent by WhatsApp, SMS or email.

reRingMinutes.label: Ring again when nobody has answered for (minutes)

maxRings.label: Ring each person at most (times)
maxRings.help: After that the call shows as missed for them.

escalateMinutes.label: Escalate when nobody is on the way after (minutes)
escalateMinutes.help: Counted from the call, then again from each escalation.

escalateTo.label: Routine and urgent calls escalate to
escalateTo.help: Each further step goes one level wider (backup on-call → head of department → whole department).

options.BACKUP_ONCALL: Backup on-call (second, then consultant on call)

autoCloseMinutes.label: Close routine and urgent calls left open after (minutes)
autoCloseMinutes.help: Emergency codes never close on their own — someone gives the all clear.

chatAnnouncementsOnly.label: Hospital-wide chat is for announcements only
chatAnnouncementsOnly.help: On: only people who manage chat can post in the “Everyone” channel; everyone still reads it.

chatRetentionDays.label: Keep chat messages for (days)
chatRetentionDays.help: 0 keeps them. Older messages and their attachments are removed by a nightly job.
